items.name: Library
items.tip: Your sample library: folders, tags, search and a preview player. Shortcut: 1.

items.name: Stems
items.tip: Stem files found next to the selected loop (names like Loop_drums, Loop_bass). Shortcut: 2.

items.name: Splice
items.tip: Pick the folder Splice saves into and watch it. No Splice login in CATalog. Shortcut: 3.

items.name: Import folder
items.tip: Add a folder of samples. Every subfolder inside it is read too, at any depth. Files stay on your computer; in this browser mockup they are read in this tab only and never uploaded.

items.name: Add files
items.tip: Add single audio files.

items.name: clear
items.tip: Clear the tag filter.

items.name: Search
items.tip: Type words from the name, tags, key or BPM. Several words must all match.

items.name: Sort
items.tip: Order of the list.

items.name: ★ Favourites
items.tip: Show only favourites.

items.name: Waveform
items.tip: Click anywhere to play from that point.

items.name: Play
items.tip: Play the selected sample. Shortcut: Space.

items.name: Loop
items.tip: Loop the sample.

items.name: Auto-play
items.tip: Play a sample as soon as you select it.

items.name: Spectrum
items.tip: Live spectrum of what is playing, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, in dB.

items.name: Pitch
items.tip: Preview pitch in semitones. It changes speed too, like a sampler. Double-click resets.

items.name: Volume
items.tip: Preview level. Double-click resets.

items.name: Sync
items.tip: Loops only: speeds the loop up or down to the host BPM.

items.name: Host BPM
items.tip: The tempo your DAW runs at. Double-click resets.
